verdict.rationale: Docs mention getting started in a free 'development mode' for testing tool calls (docs-10), implying some separation from production usage, but there is no explicit documentation of a sandbox environment, test data isolation, or guarantees that dev-mode calls don't touch real production accounts/data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-vs-prod environment docs, confirmation that test accounts are isolated from real user data, and independent verification of this isolation.
